Chapter 884: Chapter 21 Myriad Transformation Queen (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 884: Chapter 21 Myriad Transformation Queen (Please Subscribe)

“Just this?”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, checking himself inside and out again, confirming that only his life essence had been slightly reduced and that no other aspects were affected.

And the reduction of life essence was only one ten-millionth.

This…

Had no impact on Lin Yuan’s own strength.

Lin Yuan even faintly felt that this slight temporary reduction of one ten-millionth of his life essence would soon recover.

“What’s going on?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

It could be speculated that the unexplained reduction of his life essence must be the handiwork of those peak clan forces.

Such a high-level maneuver must be of a Level Twelve ultimate level, otherwise he wouldn’t have failed to notice it and lacked even the ability to resist.

However—

The acting peak clan forces probably misjudged the thickness and height of Lin Yuan’s life essence, causing the weakened life essence to seem like a drop in the ocean compared to Lin Yuan’s entire life essence.

Life essence depends on many aspects.

Such as the inner world, the physical body, the soul, the mind and will, etc.

External forces almost have no impact on life essence.

As for Lin Yuan’s life essence… Starting with his internal world, Lin Yuan’s internal world extends over 700 billion miles, compared to the normal Level Eleven Perfect which is no more than a few tens of millions to under a billion miles.

That’s tens of thousands of times more.

Next is his physical body, the extremity of refinement through the path of Martial Tao, incorporating the minute physical structures of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, the foundational enhancement from the mysterious gourd to the body, and twice receiving the Chaos Void Origin Infusion to improve his physique, etc.

Lin Yuan’s physical strength, compared to normal Level Eleven Perfect, is not any less profound.

The soul is the same, with a powerful internal world and physical body nurturing out a soul that is far beyond normal Level Eleven Perfect from the start.

Not to mention the mind and will, the previous three aspects—the internal world, physical body, and soul—haven’t stepped into Level Twelve.

But Lin Yuan’s mind and will have completely stepped into Level Twelve, and is considered powerful even among them.

With over 3,330,000 points in mind and will index, Lin Yuan suspects he surpasses quite a number of Level Twelve ultimates.

The combination of the internal world, physical body, soul, mind and will, and more makes Lin Yuan’s life essence far surpass those on the same Level Eleven Perfect.

Even if it’s not a hundred million times more, there are still tens of millions of times difference.

This aspect is also reflected in the river of time, where normal Level Eleven Perfect are merely ‘big fish’.

But Lin Yuan?

Sank to the very bottom of the river of time, his massive body dominating the entire riverbed, with slight movements stirring countless undercurrents, causing many nearby Level Eleven beings to be unsettled, even affecting the local flow speed of the river of time.

…

At the same time.

Near the central battlefield altar.

Tearing.

Over a dozen terrifying spatial rifts were ripped open.

One by one, the strongest Level Eleven from various peak clans, wielding Clan Suppression Weapons and many other treasures and techniques, aimed to strike at the Victory Altar.

“Go all out.”

The strongest Level Eleven from the Robber Clan was engulfed in infinite aura, as if many calamities had befallen him yet not affecting him in the slightest.

The rest of the strongest Level Eleven did the same, their movements unleashing powers far exceeding the limits of Level Eleven.

At this moment, the Yu Clan used a balance scale to restrict the life essence of the Galaxy Master, seizing this opportunity to kill the Galaxy Master and reclaim those most powerful weapons.

The losses of the various peak clans could thus be recovered.

As for dealing with the Galaxy Master later on… now even if they kill Galaxy Master Lin Yuan, it’s just an avatar, the real main body of the Galaxy Master is still early away, and avatars can still be formed to enter the war in the future.

After many speculations by the peak clan forces of Level Twelve ultimate, the ultimate foundation controlled by the Galaxy Master likely has a range limit.

Otherwise, the Galaxy Master wouldn’t have waited until a massive decisive battle, where tens of thousands of Level Eleven gather within hundreds of billions of miles to take action.

Knowing this point makes it easier to deal with, as long as they keep a distance from the Galaxy Master at all times.

“Kill!”

The strongest Level Eleven of the Insect Race, with cold eyes, wielding the Tribal Guardian Weapon Nightmare Realm, launched one terrifying soul attack after another without holding back.

…

Inside the Victory Altar.

Many guarding Level Eleven powerhouses appeared horrified, looking around and discovering over a dozen figures rushing towards the altar.

These dozen figures, twisting and shattering the space on the battlefield, made all Level Eleven powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance tremble in spirit.

Even Xuanyuan You felt his scalp explode, as these dozen strongest Level Eleven obviously used all their means, aimed at crushing the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Galaxy Master?”

Xuanyuan You’s heart sank, as these dozen strongest Level Eleven, daring to come so boldly, definitely had the confidence to confront the Galaxy Master.

Based on the astonishing strength Lin Yuan displayed on the battlefield ten years ago, the eleven peak clan forces would never have sent their strongest Level Eleven to die without confidence.

Since they made their move, it means they are confident, and not slightly so.

…

“Hmm?”

Sitting at the deepest part of the altar, Lin Yuan also noticed the strongest Level Eleven making their way towards him.

“First, they weaken my life essence, then they go all out, not a bad plan.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze remained calm.

It must be said, the plan laid out by the peak clan forces was perfect, surely involving the scheming of Level Twelve ultimates.
